metadata.title: Country Chic Portrait with Animal Print Textures

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered female portrait against a textured cowhide background, framed by a thin gold geometric border and anchored by large, gold-textured sans-serif typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic leopard print dress and the larger-scale cowhide background pattern.
Symmetry established by the central subject and the balanced placement of the large-scale text.
Harmonious warm color palette linking the gold text, blonde hair, and brown hide textures.
coreInvariants: Thin gold-foil geometric border with corner gaps.
Large-scale, wide-set sans-serif display type with a metallic gold texture.
Layering of the subject behind the text but in front of the background hide.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-shot portrait, occupying the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Heavy, wide-set gold text at the lower third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the leopard print dress to the large gold text, then outward to the gold border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; filled with high-contrast cowhide patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and creams from the cowhide and leopard print.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black spots in the patterns providing depth and visual rhythm.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold used for the border, text, and jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the background patterns with muted, natural saturation in the skin tones and hair.

letterConstructionRules: Wide proportions with circular 'O' and 'C' shapes.
Large x-height for maximum legibility and impact.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' features a low crossbar.
The letter 'R' has a wide, open leg.

composition.scale: Large, spanning nearly the full width

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant typeface to maintain focus on the textures and subject.
graphicDevices: Thin gold rectangular frame with intentional breaks at the corners.
Small feather icon in the bottom right corner.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern geometric structure and wide stance.
Provides the necessary circular geometric forms and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with long blonde hair wearing a leopard print dress, standing against a large brown and white cowhide rug. Include a thin gold rectangular frame that is slightly broken at the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the bottom third. Apply a realistic gold foil texture and a subtle drop shadow to the text.

verificationChecks: Is the text wide and bold enough to anchor the bottom of the frame?
Does the gold texture on the text match the gold of the border?
Is the subject centered between the background patterns?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold foil texture
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold border does not touch the edges of the canvas.
Verify the text is legible against the leopard print dress.
Check that the cowhide background has a realistic hair texture.
Confirm the gold foil effect has varied specular highlights.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + Patterned background (Hide) + Patterned clothing (Animal) + Geometric gold frame + Large gold geometric sans-serif text.
